title: HumMatch
description: Match singers to songs by vocal range: score fit, karaoke difficulty, and voice type.
summary: Match singers to songs by vocal range: score fit, karaoke difficulty, and voice type.
offersHint: Match singers to songs by vocal range: score fit, karaoke difficulty, and voice type. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://hummatch.me/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_vocal_profile
toolsPreview.description: Turn a singer's vocal range into a normalized HumMatch vocal profile: a persistent Vocal ID, voice type, and tone label. Call this first when you know someone's range and want a profile to reuse across the other HumMatch tools.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_songs
toolsPreview.description: Rank the HumMatch catalog for one singer and return the songs they can actually sing, scored for range fit, karaoke difficulty, and voice-type suitability. Call this when someone asks what they should sing, what suits their voice or range, or wants karaoke song suggestions. Returns a ranked list plus named buckets (safest picks, easy wins, crowd pleasers, songs to avoid).

toolsPreview.name: search_songs
toolsPreview.description: Search HumMatch by song title or artist. Use this to resolve a song someone named into the catalog slug that check_song_fit needs, or to look up a song's measured vocal range. Pass rangeLow/rangeHigh as well to score every result against that voice and get the hits ranked by fit.

toolsPreview.name: check_song_fit
toolsPreview.description: Score a specific catalog song against a singer's range and explain why it fits or does not, including a suggested key to transpose to. Call this when someone asks whether they can sing a particular song. Resolve the song with search_songs first to get its slug.

toolsPreview.name: group_song_fit
toolsPreview.description: Given two or more singers' ranges, find the vocal range they share and the songs that sit inside it. Call this for karaoke night with friends, a duet, a choir or worship team, or any "what can we all sing" question.
